results.title: Secret Lover: The Last Promise
results.original_title: 秘密關係 Secret Lover 最後の約束
results.overview: Childhood friends Junxi and Han Tuo have grown up side by side, sharing dreams, secrets, and an unspoken bond that deepens as they enter adulthood. When Han Tuo finally confesses his long-hidden love, their friendship shifts into a fragile romance tested by family pressure, career expectations, and the fear of losing each other. As Junxi struggles with harassment at work and Han Tuo faces demands to abandon his architectural dreams, the two must confront what they truly want. The Last Promise weaves their journey into a more emotional, cinematic arc, blending new scenes with their story of first love, courage, and the vow that could either bind them together or become their final goodbye.

results.title: English Tutor
results.overview: A rebellious teenager hates the English lessons her mother forces her to take.

results.title: Rooster Road
results.overview: On a quiet night, a drug deal turns into a tense ride to a cockfight when a dealer hitches a ride with a mysterious woman and her rooster. Flirtation, deception, and danger collide—until one deadly twist ends the game.

results.title: Hexameron
results.overview: In Europe after the outbreak of the Black Death, an ascetic monk falls in love with the Devil.

results.title: The Child They Hid
results.overview: The plot centers on an antiques store owner who gives her relatives DNA testing kits as a gift. When the store owner's family members begin turning up murdered, she edges closer to the truth only to discover that she herself is at the heart of a mystery that has put her entire family in danger.

results.title: Pool Sharks
results.overview: A young girl is terrified of the deep end.

results.title: The Future of Climbing
results.overview: With the proliferation of private climbing gyms and the sport's inclusion in the Olympic Games, climbing, long a counter-cultural movement, is undergoing a profound transformation and facing a major paradox. On the one hand, private gyms are enjoying increasing popularity, while on the other, natural climbing sites are under serious threat. What vertical legacy will we leave to future generations? Is outdoor climbing destined to disappear? What will the future hold for climbing? Led by Cédric Lachat, a multi-award-winning Swiss climber, the film provides an international overview of this counter-culture, which has recently become a social phenomenon.

results.title: The Dad Quest
results.overview: When a father-son duo learns that they may not be biologically related, the two embark on a wild adventure through Mexico to find the truth.

results.title: Marriage Bites
results.overview: Rebuilding a stale marriage, Martin and Linda face an unexpected challenge when Martin is bitten by a vampire, leading them to test vampire theories and protect their town from the undead.

results.title: Leather Graves
results.overview: Cruising in a graveyard, queers roam the permeable boundaries between exile and ecstasy.

results.title: Leleka
results.overview: Haunted by the ongoing war in Ukraine, Sasha, a Ukrainian sculptor living in Paris, creates a work in memory of her late grandmother and journeys home to honor her. Accompanied by her Belgian friend Margaux, who carries an old Bolex camera, Sasha moves through a landscape where dreams and reality begin to blur, while pages from her diary reveal her innermost feelings.

results.title: Amazing Grace: The Untold Story
results.overview: John Newton’s life is traced from his turbulent youth and years at sea to his conversion, ministry, and the first performance of the hymn “Amazing Grace” during the Great Awakening.

results.title: Kung Fu Lady Boss
results.overview: A young woman, Wu Qingqing, driven by family tragedy, embarks on a solitary, courageous path to combat Japanese invaders and internal traitors in the treacherous Shanghai underworld, embodying the spirit of patriotic duty.

results.title: Lottery
results.overview: Scientists Andrea and Sacha go door to door, delivering Lottery results to unsuspecting citizens. Andrea believes they are saving the Earth, but after encountering an unhinged woman, she'll question everything about their mission.

results.title: Second Chance
results.overview: A children’s ministry director and a criminal fall for each other as they are forced to work together at the church. As walls break down, both discover God’s love—and a second chance at healing, grace, and unexpected romance.

results.title: Dear Mother
results.overview: Julius returns home to find his mother has replaced him with Albert, a lodger who now occupies his old room-and her affections. As Julius struggles to adapt, hidden tensions resurface, unveiling a dysfunctional family dynamic.

results.title: Detective Kien: The Headless Horror
results.original_title: Thám Tử Kiên: Kỳ Án Không Đầu
results.overview: Detective Kien investigates a headless body found in a rural Vietnamese village during the Nguyen Dynasty. As supernatural elements emerge, he faces chilling twists in this 19th-century mystery.

results.title: O.C.D.
results.overview: A delivery driver struggling with OCD faces an unusual challenge when his TikToker girlfriend's attempt to help him overcome his compulsions inadvertently triggers the apocalypse.
